selection.edition: international Agility CMS Content Fetch API (US host api.aglty.io)
selection.ownership: Agility CMS (Agility Inc.), Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Headless Content Fetch REST API at api.aglty.io. The reviewed edition is the public international US host used by the pinned source, not a mainland-China product. Distinct from Agility CIS (agilitycis.com).

research.searchCoverage: Official Agility CMS Content Fetch API (APIKey header, GET /{guid}/{apiType}/contentmodels, GET /{guid}/{apiType}/{locale}/list/{referenceName}, GET /{guid}/{apiType}/{locale}/item/{id}, GET /{guid}/{apiType}/{locale}/page/{id}, GET /{guid}/{apiType}/{locale}/sitemap/flat/{channelName}), swagger at api.aglty.io/swagger, Toronto operator identity, and dated incident search for Agility CMS / agilitycms.com security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. Agility CIS 2025 ransomware hits are a distinct New Zealand billing product. No qualifying current unresolved Agility CMS customer-data compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

research.edition: international Agility CMS Content Fetch API (US host api.aglty.io)
research.searchCoverage: Official Content Fetch REST API at https://api.aglty.io with APIKey header was confirmed on 2026-09-13. Operator is Agility CMS in Toronto, Canada. Dated incident search found no qualifying unresolved Agility CMS compromise. Agility CIS (agilitycis.com) 2025 Play ransomware coverage is a distinct product.

incidents.finding: Agility CIS (agilitycis.com), a New Zealand customer-information/billing vendor, was listed in 2025 ransomware coverage. That operator is not Agility CMS (agilitycms.com).
incidents.limitation: Name collision only; not evidence against Agility CMS.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential healthcheck maps to GET /{guid}/{apiType}/contentmodels, the cheap authenticated read used by the pinned validator when guid is present.
guid and apiType are per-request path inputs, matching pinned handlers rather than the optional stored guid extra field.
Pinned source always uses https://api.aglty.io. Official docs also list api-ca.aglty.io, api-eu.aglty.io, and api-aus.aglty.io; those regional hosts are not admitted.

Native category is productivity (source Developer Tools / Productivity). Nested sitemap, sync, and Management API writes are omitted. The upstream user-agent is not sent. Raw JSON is returned under data.

Maps to official GET /{guid}/{apiType}/{locale}/list/{referenceName}. take, skip, and fields map to Take, Skip, and Fields as in pinned runtime. Filter, Sort, Direction, ContentLinkDepth, and ExpandAllContentLinks are omitted.

Maps to official GET /{guid}/{apiType}/{locale}/item/{id}. Optional contentLinkDepth and expandAllContentLinks use the lowercase query names from pinned get_content_item, not the PascalCase list names.
Maps to official GET /{guid}/{apiType}/{locale}/page/{id} with optional lowercase contentLinkDepth and expandAllContentLinks.
Maps to official GET /{guid}/{apiType}/{locale}/sitemap/flat/{channelName}.
Maps to official GET /{guid}/{apiType}/{locale}/sitemap/nested/{channelName}.
Maps to official GET /{guid}/{apiType}/{locale}/page/{channel} with optional path, contentLinkDepth, and expandAllContentLinks query parameters.
Maps to official GET /{guid}/{apiType}/gallery/{id}.
Maps to official GET /{guid}/{apiType}/{locale}/sync/items with syncToken and pageSize.
Maps to official GET /{guid}/{apiType}/{locale}/sync/pages with syncToken and pageSize.
Maps to official GET /{guid}/{apiType}/urlredirection with optional lastAccessDate.

Maps to Management API POST /api/v1/instance/{guid}/{locale}/item. Sends Authorization Bearer using the stored apiKey (a Personal Access Token) in addition to the Fetch APIKey header. Host is mgmt.aglty.io.
Maps to Management API GET /api/v1/instance/{guid}/{locale}/item/{id}/publish.
Maps to Management API GET /api/v1/instance/{guid}/{locale}/item/{id}/unpublish.
Maps to Management API DELETE /api/v1/instance/{guid}/{locale}/item/{id}.
Maps to Management API GET /api/v1/instance/{guid}/{locale}/page/{id}/publish.
Maps to Management API DELETE /api/v1/instance/{guid}/{locale}/page/{id}.
Maps to Management API GET /api/v1/instance/{guid}/container/list.
Maps to Management API GET /api/v1/instance/{guid}/asset/list.
Maps to Management API GET /api/v1/instance/{guid}/locales.
